title: French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa hit by $133M cyberattack
excerpt: Hackers stole up to $133 million from French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa through an attack involving a service provider.
body_html:
French cooperative bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa has suffered a major cyberattack that resulted in fraudulent transactions reaching up to $133 million.

The threat actors managed to carry out the heist by targeting a service provider connected to the institution. Following the security incident, the financial organization took swift action to respond to the breach.

As part of its containment and mitigation efforts, the bank was forced to temporarily suspend certain operational systems while investigating how the unauthorized transactions were executed.
